name: Handcuffs
concept: Police chain handcuffs for 1989 Everon: a pair of steel chain cuffs, the kind every officer carries on the duty belt. An on-duty officer holds them in the left hand and restrains a downed or held-up suspect with them; the cuffs go onto the suspect and come back to the officer on release.
prompt: A pair of steel police handcuffs lying flat. Two round closed cuff rings side by side, each ring about as wide as a wrist, made of a thick flat curved steel bar. Each cuff has a solid rectangular lock box on one side with a small keyhole. The two lock boxes face each other and are joined by a short chain of three thick oval steel links with clear gaps between the links. Classic 1980s chain handcuffs, clean hard-surface industrial design, single object, no text, no logos, no hands, no key, no stand.
texture_prompt: Polished nickel-plated steel with a cool grey sheen, slightly darker steel inside the lock boxes and keyholes, light scratches and edge wear, no text, no logos, flat neutral lighting.
maps_note: The generated maps read as polished chrome in daylight. tone-maps.py (beside this spec) darkens the base colour, roughens and lowers the metallic before the clean stage; rerun it after any new generate.
